## History

Emily is a student from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who attends Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside [Anne](../character/anne.md) and other schoolmates. After relocating to town, she adjusts to her new academic environment and classes. She later visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) at her boarding house room with fellow classmates to share news regarding the upcoming Avery scholarship.
